audit.why: Lane difficulty is accurately framed: Vex owns early (Azir pre-stacks is short-ranged), 6 is a skill duel around Emperor's Divide, two items flips to Azir. Content layer states this correctly.
Spikes are right: W at 2, full kit at 3, R at 6, Luden's, and Azir's 2-item soldier zone inversion. spikes[] names real abilities (Mistral Bolt, Shadow Surge, Emperor's Divide, Looming Darkness).

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart carries a blanket 'Skill' on all seven rows while content win[] and the packet chart both say Vex 1-5, Skill at first item, Azir at 2+ items. Cooldowns field has no digit. Two Do's/Don'ts bodies are the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted verbatim. The missing-interaction (Shifting Sands E shield absorbing burst) is now stated with its 22/16s cooldown.
audit.why: regression-check fails a chart where the two layers disagree; the content layer and packet agree with each other, so the full layer is the stale side.
audit.corrected: phases 0-4 side to Vex, phase 6 to Azir, whys rewritten to match the verdicts; cooldowns given real numbers (E 22s rank 1 / 16 max, R 120/105/90).

edits.before: Q-poke the last-hits — the accelerating bolt chips from a deceptive range and Gloom marks tax every connect.
edits.after: Azir pre-soldiers is squishy and short-ranged — Q-poke his last-hits freely; he has no answer before W stacks arrive.

edits.before: W online: the shield-fear pulse means anyone who dashes onto you regrets the itinerary.
edits.after: W online while his lone soldier is fragile — the shield-fear pulse plus Q out-trades his short pokes.

edits.before: Full kit: E-mark into Q-fear is your trade engine — every passive proc is crowd control he scheduled for you.
edits.after: Full kit beats his ramp: E-mark into Q-fear lands before soldier DPS stacks — you dictate every trade at 3.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — mark-and-bolt every wave contact; the fear windows zone harder than the damage.
edits.after: He still lacks the range to punish your walk-ups — mark-and-bolt every wave contact and keep denying his stacks.

edits.before: Shadow Surge online — any skirmish in missile range is now your business; the reset execute travels.
edits.after: Shadow Surge pick threat outpaces Emperor's Divide — his R only peels, yours executes across 2000 range.

edits.before: Late Vex is anti-engage incarnate: their dive feeds your fears, your R feeds on their deaths.
edits.after: Two items in, stacked soldiers out-range everything you have — flank R onto Azir before they set, or leave.

edits.before: - Azir Shifting Sands: matchup-defining — His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Personal Space for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Azir Shifting Sands (E): 22s at rank 1, 16 at max — his shield-dash absorbs your burst, so force it before you commit. - Emperor's Divide (R): 120/105/90s — while it's down your R dash can't be walled. Budget W for emergencies, R for opportunities.

edits.before: E-mark the contact, Q through the marked line for the fear, auto, walk — every trade he answers with a dash just schedules the next fear.
edits.after: Doom's empowered Q fears through his soldier line — and if he E-dashes at your poke, the dash marks him and refunds the next fear sooner.

edits.before: Spending the W pulse on poke spacing and then eating the real engage unfeared — the pulse is the matchup against everything that moves fast.
edits.after: Shifting Sands shields him as he closes — poke thrown into that window is absorbed and the dash lands with the trade already lost for you.

notes: Full-layer chart carried a blanket 'Skill' on all 7 rows; content win[] and packet agree (Vex 1-5, Skill first item, Azir 2+ items), so sides were moved with matching why rewrites and no content edits were needed (win[] already correct — no-op edits avoided per chart rule). Missing interaction (E shield absorbs burst, 22s rank 1) folded into breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[2].d. All three lintFindings fixed.
